parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the SLB instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡实例地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the TLS policy
parameters.name: tls_cipher_policy_id

parameters.help_en: Policy Name of the TLS policy. Policy Name must be 2 to 200 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Policy Name must start with a letter
parameters.help_zh: TLS策略名称。长度为2~200个英文或中文字符，必须以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return associated listener information. Valid values:

true: Returns associated listener information.
false (default): Does not return associated listener information
parameters.help_zh:
是否返回关联的监听信息。取值：

true：返回。
false（默认）：不返回
parameters.name: include_listener

parameters.help_en:
The token that determines the start point of the next query. Valid values:
You do not need to set this parameter for the first query or if no next query exists.
If a next query exists, set the value to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of TLS policies to return. Valid values: 1 to 100. If you leave this parameter empty, the default value 20 is used
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大TLS策略数，取值：1~100。设置为空时，默认值为20
parameters.name: max_items

IsTruncated.description_en:
Indicates whether the results are truncated. Valid values:

true: The current page is the last page.

false: More pages are available
IsTruncated.description_zh:
是否结束。取值：

true：表示当前页是最后一页。

false：表示还有下一页

NextToken.description_en:
The token that determines the start point of the next query. Valid values:
If NextToken is empty, no next query exists.
If NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

items.description_en:
The supported cipher suite, which depends on the value of TLSVersions.

TLSv1.0 and TLSv1.1 support: 

ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA 
ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA
ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA 
ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA 
AES128-SHA AES256-SHA 
DES-CBC3-SHA

TLSv1.2 supports:

ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA 
ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA 
ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA 
ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA 
AES128-SHA AES256-SHA 
DES-CBC3-SHA 
ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256 
ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384 
ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA256 
ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA384 
ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256 
ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384 
ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256 
ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384  
AES128-GCM-SHA256 
AES256-GCM-SHA384 
AES128-SHA256 AES256-SHA256

TLSv1.3 supports: 

TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256
TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384
TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256
TLS_AES_128_CCM_SHA256
TLS_AES_128_CCM_8_SHA256
